author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Nicholas Sanchez scored his first Brown goal in the 59th minute to lift the Bears to a 1-0 victory over Stonehill on Friday night at Stevenson-Pincince Field. Carlo Brown started the decisive move, Lorenzo Amaral delivered the final pass and Sanchez placed his shot into the top corner beyond goalkeeper Felix Van Der Hagen.

Brown controlled much of the attacking play, finishing with a 23-9 advantage in shots and putting seven attempts on target. Stonehill managed only one shot on goal. Bears goalkeeper Graham Kois stopped it to secure his second clean sheet of the season, while the defense protected the narrow lead through the final half hour.

The result gave Brown a second consecutive win, improved its record to 3-1 and kept the team unbeaten at home. The Bears are now 3-0 all time against Stonehill, which fell to 2-2-2. Brown will stay in Providence for the next game of its four-match homestand, hosting in-state rival Rhode Island on Tuesday, September 15, at 7 p.m.
dek: Nicholas Sanchez scored in the 59th minute and Graham Kois posted his second clean sheet as the Bears won their second straight.
headline: Sanchez goal carries Brown past Stonehill 1-0
